died.name: Anne Askew
died.cause: when offered letter of pardon before being burned at the stake for heresy
died.last_words: I came not hither to deny my Lord and Master.

died.name: Pierre-Jean de Béranger
died.last_words: My God, my God! Enlighten us. Inspire in a united mankind the love of the good, the love of well being.-To do good, to live for others-that's happiness. Charity, charity, for all the world to be happy. -Widows, small boys-help them.

born.name: Ennius
born.cause: lines dictated to be engraved on his memorial. Only fragments of his works now survive
born.last_words: Let no one weep for me, or celebrate my funeral with mourning; for I still live, as I pass to and fro through the mouths of men.

born.name: Joshua Reynolds
born.last_words: I have been fortunate in long good health and constant success, and I ought not to complain. I know that all things on earth must have an end, and now I am come to mine.

born.name: Emerson H. Liscum
born.cause: dying after being shot at the Battle of Tientsin

born.name: Eugène Ysaÿe
born.cause: Belgian violinist, composer and conductor, after his Fourth Sonata was played for him
born.last_words: Splendid. The finale just a little too fast.

born.name: Violette Neatley Anderson
born.desc: first African-American woman to practice law before the United States Supreme Court
born.cause: speaking to Claude Albert Barnett while dying of cancer prior to Zeta Phi Beta's annual boule
born.last_words: Tell the girls to keep on going ahead. Put over the boule with a bang. Don't let my passing throw the slightest shadow of gloom. The organization has a grand mission before it.
